programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: The Shaw Brothers directors created this 60s classic depicting a timeless romance between a wealthy man and a songbird.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Set in the Warring States period of ancient China, this drama tells the story of Nieh Cheng, one of historys greatest political assassins.

programme.title: Love Without End 1961
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan, capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: Chang Cheh presents his epic vision of the Temple, featuring his favourite leads Ti Lung, David Chiang and Alexander Fu Sheng.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: This comedy centres on the residents of a females-only apartment who hail from different backgrounds and make money in varied ways.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: This hard-hitting drama is based on a real-life investigation on the involvement of both cops as well as crooks in second offences.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Sek Kin takes a refreshing break from his usual villains role, playing a friendly ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his separated parents.

programme.title: Temple of the Red Lotus
programme.desc: When the family that a man named Wu Jimmy Wang Yu marries into comes under repeated attack, he suspects that his in-laws are bandits.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: As a young clan member rises to helm the Dragon gang after his foster fathers death, an incriminating letter changes everything. Can he fight the tide?

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung stars in this riveting swordswoman epic, as he embarks on a quest to find a missing martial arts manual.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: Catch this rare gem, a product of Hong Kong-style science fiction, complete with out-of-this-world visual effects.

programme.title: Killers on Wheels
programme.desc: While taking a ferry on the way to a vacation, Kwok and his family meet a road thug who puts an ugly spin on their holiday plans.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: In this award-winning classic, a beauty disguises herself as a boy to attend school yet tend to her lover. Stars Lo Ti, Ling Po.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Martial arts maestro Lo Wei wrote, directed and co-starred in this tale of greed and lust for financial gain that depicts a family brought to its knees.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: A young womans life turns tragic after she discovers that shes adopted and then goes in search of her real mother.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin loyalists led by Alexander Fu Sheng and Chen Kuan Tai go up against a formidable Manchu general and his Tibetan allies.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperors seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: This wuxia films swordsman hero must go against many treacherous warriors to solve the murder of three clan heads.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Starring teenage heartthrob Pat Ting Hung, this film marks the directing debut of the kung-fu film genres most respected figure, Chang Cheh.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chang Cheh presents this ultimate depiction of dysfunctional kung fu masters, overcoming their shortcomings to win the day, one corpse at a time.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: A nightclub owner Peter Chen Ho has his way with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Also starring Lily Ho, Chin Ping.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chang Yi play a noble swordsman and a one-armed swordswoman who find themselves up against the evil Crimson Charm gang of thieves and thugs.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild Chinas team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk and Inspector Lau are stuck in their investigation for bribery and money laundering cases. Framed for bribery, Luk risks everything to gather evidence to clear his name.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his lifes hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Mings mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor a professional assassin.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a retired stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. But due to his debts, he might lose his horse, so he seeks help from his estranged daughter her boyfriend.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his fathers death, he enlists his fathers always-drunk bodyguard to help him out.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A Japanese security agent teams up with a master thief to recover counterfeit USD plates until a U.S. Embassy official betrays them and escapes to Korea with the prize.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: Song of Spring
programme.desc: This is a touching story about an 85-year-old mother caring for her 65-year-old daughter with Alzheimers disease.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Right-hand man to a Macau tycoon, Zun Fei, is torn between love and justice amid brutal underworld violence and power struggles. When a deadly gamble turns against him, his life hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: Man On the Edge
programme.desc: A triad leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business, but Ah Lok is actually an undercover policeman who unveils a shocking political conspiracy.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his clients innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty Mission Impossible! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consorts craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yens family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the speed gang, led by Johnny, and Kuos sister Carrie is molested by Johnnys brother Michael. Kuos family continues to be harassed by the speed gang while on the island can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clans fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: Theres no place like home.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fishermans honour but accidentally kills the governors son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the rivers edge, he is rescued by the fishermans daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his sons arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her masters family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.desc: 平凡匠心是一部系列人物纪录片它以平凡人，非凡梦为主题，讲述精彩而极致的人生故事节目里的主人公遍及当代中国社会各个阶层，每个人在生活方式事业选择上都拥有独特的梦想和追求，或开风气之先，领时代之新，或执着本色，坚守初心，在各自的职业生涯中创新与坚守.

programme.title: 远方的家 On the Way
programme.desc: 节目通过旅行者深度游来表现中国的自然和人文之美及中国人眼中的世界之美，反映当代中国人旅行态度和生活观念的变化.

programme.title: 中国新闻 China News

programme.title: 中国文艺 China Showbiz
programme.desc: 为综合性专题文艺栏目以弘扬中华民族传统文化播撒五千年古老文明关注中国与世界重大的文艺活动用精彩的电视文艺作品为海内外华人观众打开一扇精神视窗为目标.

programme.title: 中国新闻 China News （Live）
programme.desc: 节目形态为滚动直播，内容为要闻荟萃它以迅速报道滚动播出新近发生的重要国内整点新闻为宗旨，强化时效性，突出快节奏，体现对新闻事件的连续追踪.

programme.title: 今日亚洲 Asia Today

programme.title: 国家记忆 Memory of China
programme.desc: 中国第一档国史节目，以为国家留史，为民族留记，为人物立传为宗旨，展现党史国史军史中的重大历史事件各领域重大工程建设揭秘重大决策背后的故事讲述各阶层各时代代表性人物，记录讲述党的奋斗史创业史中国特色社会主义探索史改革开放进程史.

programme.title: 海峡两岸 Across the Strait
programme.desc: 中央电视台唯一的涉台时事新闻评论栏目节目宗旨是跟踪海峡热点，反映两岸民意，节目分为两个版块：第一个是热点扫描，主要报道当日的近期台湾岛内的热点新闻；第二个是热点透视，当日或近期涉台热点深度报道及两岸专家对此事的评论，并对两岸各个层面的交流交往进行跟踪报道.

programme.title: 今日关注 Focus Today

programme.title: 走遍中国 Around China
programme.desc: 主要以中国的某一城市（或地域或主题）为选题范围，选取其最具的历史传承风土人情杰出人物自然风光和发展变化以连续一周每天30分钟播出的大容量，向世界全景式地展现新世纪的中国城市（或地域）形象.

programme.title: 新闻联播 Network News
programme.desc: 新闻联播是中国中央电视台于1978年1月1日创办的综合性新闻节目该栏目由中央电视台牵头主办全国各省级电视台合办旨在囊括国内外要闻，宣传党和政府的路线方针政策，反映群众呼声，提供各种重要信息它的收视率雄居中央电视台各档节目的首位，是国内外观众群最庞大影响最广泛的电视新闻栏目.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witchbut can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrants plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own Drunken Fist style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiaos spirit is revived to take revenge when the dolls eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Huas hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the others mole.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob bosss collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the citys patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.desc: 一次偶然的机会，阿轮在沙滩救了患上失忆症的盈盈，并招呼她回家中居住盈盈不单美丽性感，还身手了得，帮助阿轮收坏胀，把欺负他的女友打走盈盈心算比计算器还要快，且赌术精湛，麻雀赌波赛马，她无一不精通阿轮深深的爱上了盈盈，向她求婚，可惜在婚礼举行前夕，盈盈突然失踪当阿轮找到她时，原来她已在参加亚洲赌王大赛，对手是无恶不作的赌场大鳄仇曼联，她还有一个未婚夫亨利阿轮呆住了：难道这一趟他又好梦成空？.

programme.title: 武替道 Stuntman
programme.desc: 因昔日拍档导演希望完成其人生最后一部作品，过气动作导演李森重出江湖担任动作指导他与一位雄心壮志的年轻动作演员，两代人为了重振名声，甘愿赔上一切同时，李森必须克服自己的坏脾气，面对过去的错误，并努力修补与疏离女儿之间破裂的关系.

programme.title: 不是你不爱你 Love at First Lie
programme.desc: 那年暑假，性格开朗善良的平凡少女阿宝偶遇不务正业的富家子家伟为报复父亲再婚，家伟聘用阿宝及其好友等人捣乱婚礼，促成他与阿宝认识并开始交往两人情投意合，尝尽热恋甜蜜，岂料命运却为这段爱情安排了急转直下的暗涌.

programme.title: BBS乡民的正义 Silent Code
programme.desc: 记者蓝苡晴授命在网络上找新闻，意外闯入超红的BBS网络论坛李澄湘是创立梦想板的板主，原意是让网友们分享彼此的梦想，却因为一段不该外流的影片而成为人肉搜索的主角苡晴一路追查下去，发现事实的真相越来越复杂.

programme.title: 逆鳞 Untouchable
programme.desc: 尊非投身黑白两道通吃的富商黄朝晋门下，成为其左右手他既要面对帮派厮杀与权力暗斗，还陷于人性的复杂博弈，更在情义与道义之间反复挣扎最终，他被迫卷入一场以生命为筹码的生死赌局.

programme.title: 一秒钟 One Second
programme.desc: 著名导演张艺谋执导，叙述文化大革命期间被送往劳改营的平民，为找女儿在电影中新闻报导一秒钟出现了的菲林，不惜从劳改营逃走一路上，他遇上一个孤女，二人同样要找到那卷电影菲林最后平民可否将菲林顺利交给电影放映员，让电影在大屏幕播出？.

programme.title: 不日成婚 2 Ready OR Rot
programme.desc: 阿佳和可怡二人终于要结婚，却遇到佳母施加压力，令二人产生种种摩擦另一边，灰熊又怀疑妻子红杏出墙而当阿健的女友 Jessica意外怀孕时，他陷入人生最迷茫而不知应该如何做决定的时候众人最后可否化解他们感情上的冲突？.

programme.title: 蛟龙行动 Operation Hadal
programme.desc: 深海特种部队接获紧急任务，协同潜艇龙鲸号深入大洋，阻止国际势力策动的超级潜艇阴谋海底战场险象环生，面对敌方的重重伏击与火山口密布的极限深渊，龙鲸号在生死边缘展开极限周旋在这片无人知晓的幽闭深海，一场关乎全球命运赌上性命的终极决战正式打响.

programme.title: 破地狱 The Last Dance
programme.desc: 在疫情肆虐生意萧条的情况下，债台高筑的婚礼策划师道生转型为葬礼经纪人，寻求新的出路凭借创新且独特的经营策略，道生意外获得成功；在德高望重的喃呒师傅文哥的启发下，他的职业观与人生态度随之逐渐蜕变.

programme.title: 长津湖 The Battle at Lake Changjin
programme.desc: 1950年冬天，韩战时期的一场血战在冰天雪地的长津湖区域展开中国军队面对极端严寒的天气和饥饿，以及巨大武器差距等诸多艰险条件时，依旧毫无惧色，顽强抗战，视死如归，并取得抗美援朝战争中最为关键的一场决定性胜利.

programme.title: 红豆 Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: 张家经营着位于九龙城的中式甜品店，然而母亲突发中风，令一家人陷入剧变女儿为了维持甜品店的生意，不得不放弃成为空姐的梦想，却在过程中与父亲产生冲突他们一家能否齐心协力，克服重重难关？.

programme.title: 鬼同你住 Coffin Homes
programme.desc: 这是一部以香港住房问题为背景的惊栗讽刺式电影，当中有三个离奇怪异的故事交织在一起不断飙升的房地产价格，迫使市民要用尽一切方法去确保至少有个狭小的居住空间，即使要与亡者同住也在所不计.

programme.title: 赏金猎人 Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: 赏金猎人团，成员包括李山阿YoCatSwan和Bobo，要揪出恐吓国际酒店集团的连环爆炸案的始作俑者但SwanCat和Bobo却遭炸弹事件的幕后操纵者绑架，究竟李山和阿Yo可否将他们救出？赏金猎人团又能完成任务吗？.

programme.title: 美国女孩 American Girl
programme.desc: 2003年初，移民洛杉矶的芳仪因母亲罹患乳癌，要回到台北迎接新生活面对新学校和疏离多年的父亲，只有13岁的芳仪十分忧虑，亦因此与母亲的关系变差当芳仪的妹妹被误诊感染SARS的时候，一家人被迫隔离，进而解开彼此的心结.

programme.title: 靠近我一点. I Believe
programme.desc: 等了初恋男友10年的林楚楚，最终等来的是男友和别人的婚礼正当她对感情失去信心的时候，一位婚礼策划师和一位高富帅男神同时出现在楚楚的生活中，陪她走出了这段黑暗时光面对同样真挚的两个人，楚楚的感情也来到了必须抉择的十字路口，她最后会如何抉择？.

programme.title: 猎金游戏 A Gilded Game
programme.desc: 野心勃勃的金融高材生高寒，适逢好友的家族企业正筹备在香港上市，因而被引荐进入投行实习在首席分析师张托德的带领下，高迅速崭露头角，却因野心作祟而背叛恩师，转投竞争对手当好友的家族企业被敌意收购时，为了弥补过失，高恳求张相助，连手阻止这场恶意收购.

programme.title: 赎梦 Peg O My Heart
programme.desc: 精神科医生文思豪为夜更的士司机蔡辛强进行治疗蔡辛强深受睡眠的恐惧折磨，已无法分辨梦境与现实随着治疗展开，文医生也逐渐陷入一场令人不安的梦魇之中这场愈演愈烈的恶梦，究竟源于被压抑的记忆，还是揭开蔡辛强秘密所付出的代价？.

programme.title: 太平年 Swords Into PlowShares
programme.desc: 太平年描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷钱弘俶赵匡胤郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱秩序崩溃生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，纳土归宋，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ag

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 Warm And Sweet
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地 Offliners, The
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融地产商业是贴地举动，富二代王子菲龚嘉欣饰却偏爱离地，与好友许正伟陈智燊饰开设初创科技公司一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希张振朗饰的厉害，邀他加入公司信希是一名离地毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱刘佩玥饰帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤李国麟饰弟王梓龙罗梓龙饰信希之妹丁信恩黄心颖饰身上！.

programme.title: 溏心风暴3 Heart And Greed
programme.desc: 凌丽荧李司棋与丈夫黄永正夏雨凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风黄宗泽更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟李国麟助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华关菊英及亲弟梁赞阮兆祥大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧米雪有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家王浩信与许家独生女许贝儿岑丽香相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱陈敏之与有妇之夫郑立安唐文龙的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文黄翠如关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴.

programme.title: 醋娘子 Lady Sour
programme.desc: 曹青胡杏儿与母亲曹曹闭月黄淑仪结伴行医跑江湖，先后认识了患皮肤病的计准吴卓羲和同乡钱通罗仲谦，曹青对钱通一见钟情，千方百计嫁入钱家，可惜醋坊当家钱霜陈炜因与闭月有积怨对曹青百般阻挠，计准因病治愈献计助曹青得偿所愿，曹青入门后以为一劳永逸，谁料钱通深爱丫环山楂岑丽香，曹青乘机搞乱，反令山楂和钱通意外发生关系，钱通纳山楂为妾，令曹青醋意大发，火上加油突然，一具尸骸被发现，闭月被告谋害亲夫判处死刑，钱家怕名声受损，要求曹青与闭月断绝母女关系，此际，曹青竟发现有喜，却惹来一场休妻大行动.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always And Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

Afifa meminta Lisa menghapuskan SakaSara. Mbah Nira marahkan mereka, namun selepas diketahui Sara adalah mangsa rogol dia merelakannya. programme.title: Losmen Melati EP7
programme.desc: Melati, Golok, Sigit dan Ari bersiap sedia untuk melawan Kusno. Sara memasuki losmen mencari Fadil tetapi akhirnya terperangkap di salah satu bilik. Di sana, dia mendapati Fadil terperangkap dalam perigi dari episod 4. Diserang oleh roh rumah, Sara cuba menyelamatkan Fadil dan akhirnya mengorbankan dirinya dalam proses itu. Melati meyakinkan arwah rumah untuk berpihak kepadanya dalam perjuangannya menentang Kusno. Kusno dan Pemburu menyerang Losmen Melati. Sigit berbaik semula dengan Ari atas kengerian masa lalunya dan menentang ayahnya untuk kebaikan. Kini keluar dari perigi, Fadil cuba keluar dari rumah tetapi tersedut untuk melawan Kusno. Berjuang melawan Kusno sendiri, Fadil berada di ambang kematian apabila Kusno menggigitnya, membiarkan kutukan memasuki sistemnya. Apabila semua kelihatan hilang untuk Melati, dia mendedahkan senjata rahsianya - Watih, yang Kusno dipercayai telah mati, kembali untuk memberikan pukulan maut terakhir, akhirnya mengalahkan Kusno sekali dan untuk selama-lamanya. Namun apabila hari baru menjelma, Fadil muncul semula, tetapi semuanya tidak seperti yang disangka. Mata Fadil menjadi hitam, membayangkan kisah Losmen Melati belum berakhir.

programme.desc: Jom Fesyen merupakan program berteraskan kepada pamakaian wanita Muslimah. Jom Fesyen membawa penonton mengenali, menyaksikan kreativiti pereka tempatan yang menghasilkan busana Muslimah di pasaran.

programme.title: Alhamdulillah
programme.desc: Episod Alhamdulillah kali ini bersama Dato Alha Alfa yang akan merungkai rahsia di sebalik kejayaan personaliti yang berjaya di Malaysia bagaimana permulaan kehidupan mereka untuk hidup dan kisah kejayaan seseorang usahawan dalam bidang yang diusahakan.

programme.title: Umar Hatta
programme.desc: Ketika Leyla sedang menangis sendirian di lobi hospital, dia telah berkenalan dengan Nadia, wanita muslimah yang menarik Leyla kembali ke jalan yang lurus lagi benar. Dengan mengingat Tuhan, Leyla mula menemui ketenangan. Dia juga mampu mengawal diri dan melupakan kekhilafan suaminya, malah berusaha memujuk Hatta agar bertaubat. Berkat bimbingan Nadia dan suaminya, Dr. Farhan, Leyla dan Hatta mampu berubah. Gaya hidup bebas yang mereka jalani sebelum ini digantikan dengan gaya hidup berlandaskan sunnah. Jika sebelum ini mereka hanya solat bila ada masa, tapi kini mereka mengutamakan masa solat dari lain-lain perkara.

programme.title: Jejak Rasul - Nabi Muhammad SAW
programme.desc: Memaparkan fasa baru seruan dakwah Nabi di Mekah setelah 3 tahun menerima wahyu dan menyeru secara rahsia. Juga diceritakan cabaran dan tentangan yang dihadapi oleh Nabi Muhammad dalam menyampaikan kebenaran.

programme.title: Deko Ibadah

Menggabungkan elemen dekorasi dan pengisian Islam, program ini membantu mewujudkan persekitaran yang lebih kondusif untuk beribadah dan menghayati nilai-nilai murni.

programme.title: ustazmasak

Episod kali ini bersama dengan Dai Muhammad sebagai ustaz jemputan dan destinasi mereka kali ini di Selangor Fruit Valley untuk membawakan menu yang berasaskan buah belimbing.

programme.title: Di Sisimu Aku
programme.desc: Qeena pergi ke firma guaman untuk urusan kerja. Qeena sangat terkejut dengar nama orang yang akan berurusan dengannya. Nama orang itu ialah Aman Zarul. Qeena tertanya sendiri, siapakah orang dimaksudkan. Adakah Aman Zarul yang pernah dia kenali bertahun lalu? Tiba-tiba muncul wanita bertanya tentang Aman kepada kerani, Qeena kenal wanita itu. Zeyra. Jika itu Zeyra. Maka, Aman Zarul yang akan berurusan dengan Qeena adalah Aman Zarul yang Qeena kenal. Qeena tidak mahu dan tidak sanggup bertemu dengan Aman. Qeena balik tanpa selesaikan urusan kerja.

programme.desc: Tamatlah sesi pembelajaran di Universiti, Raze dan rakan-rakannya membuat cadangan untuk pergi bercuti. Namun, suatu masalah terjadi ke atas Raze setelah Rihana mengatakan bahawa tiada siapa yang boleh menjaga atuknya di kampung. Raze menolak sekerasnya tetapi atas pujukan mamanya, Raze tetap pulang ke kampung untuk menjaga atuknya dalam keadaan terpaksa.

programme.desc: Ali dan Alia merupakan pasangan kembar yang sangat rapat sejak kecil. Namun kehidupan mereka mula berubah apabila kedua ibu bapa mereka terlalu sibuk bekerja hingga menyebabkan mereka berasa terabai, terutama Alia yang menghidap autisme.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Jamil masih memancing di kolam renang rumah mewah itu, Qistina mendapat panggilan untuk membawa Jamil ke rancangan radio. Qistina jadi buntu untuk memujuk Jamil daripada berhenti memancing di kolam renang itu. Jamil mengatakan dia tidak pernah berputus asa dalam mencari rezeki untuk dimakan, hal itu membuatkan Qistina terdesak untuk menipu Jamil. Sebenarnya Qistina ini seorang mata duitan dan pandai mengambil kesempatan. Melihat dari perwatakan Jamil yang lurus bendul, Qistina segera mengambil kesempatan yang kononnya nampak mahu membantu Jamil sedangkan segala wang Jamil Qistina akan simpan di dalam poketnya sendiri.

programme.title: Assalamualaikum Subuh L

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.desc: Ripples of Time explores the history of Kuchings kampungs along Sungai Sarawak, tracing their journey from early settlements to modern-day development, highlighting stories of heritage, displacement, and resilience.

programme.title: Sumandak Takes Borneo
programme.desc: Dewi Remaja 2022 winner Tracie and two friends explore Borneos beautyfood, history, culture, nature, and diversitywhile uplifting communities through local social enterprises in this inspiring travelogue.

programme.title: DL TVS Highlight
programme.desc: TVS Highlight showcases the most current and important news in a compact, well-rounded format, featuring both local and international updates with thorough and succinct reporting.

programme.title: TVS Fillers
programme.desc: TVS Fillers delivers quick, engaging segments on Sarawakian culture, local trends, and more, keeping viewers entertained between programs.

programme.title: Kamek, Ali Wallace
programme.desc: Alfred Russel Wallaces study in Southeast Asia relied on Ali, a Malay teen from Sarawak, who helped collect 125,660 specimens over 8 years, contributing to The Malay Archipelago and earning global recognition in natural history.

programme.title: Khazanah Kenyalang
programme.desc: Sebuah siri dokumentari 13 episod tentang koleksi dan artifak berharga dan sangat penting yang kini menjadi KHAZANAH NEGERI SARAWAK dan berada dalam simpanan MUZIUM NEGERI SARAWAK.

programme.title: DL TVS Ringkas
programme.desc: TVS Ringkas brings the latest breaking news, offering quick and essential updates from both within the country and around the globe.

programme.title: TVS Music
programme.desc: TVS Music is a compilation of songs that celebrates the rich and diverse musical talents of the region, featuring a mix of contemporary hits and culturally inspired tracks from local artists.

programme.title: Serian Food Trails Stays
programme.desc: Serian reveals not only a colourful lifestyle and palatable cuisine but also limestone hills, waterfalls, and lush trekking paths that lead to unforgettable homestay experiences. All of this unfolds in the villages, where the stories of locals who have made their mark in their communities come to life.

programme.title: Setenang Mata Memandang
programme.desc: Travelogue program that follows two hosts on their journey to discover hidden gems in Sarawaks natural beauty, including national parks, mountains, valleys, lakes, rivers, waterfalls, and islands.

programme.title: L Berita Wilayah TVS
programme.desc: Berita Wilayah TVS membawakan berita dari negeri-negeri di seluruh negara.

programme.title: HITS 122
programme.desc: HITS 122: Edisi AIM25 is a 13-episode television journey that celebrates 25 years of Malaysian music excellence while building nationwide excitement towards the AIM25 Awards Night in Kuching, Sarawak.

programme.title: L Re Bao
programme.desc: Re Bao memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Mandarin

programme.title: VitalMotion
programme.desc: VitalMotion is a dynamic and flexible exercise program designed to make fitness accessible for everyone.

programme.title: Bridging Borneo
programme.desc: Bridging Borneo is a documentary series that features 6 bridges and the places of interest that it connects to along the Sarawak coastal road network. These bridges span over iconic rivers to bring communities closer, foster economic growth and make travel easier.

programme.title: L Berita Iban TVS
programme.desc: Berita Iban memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Iban

programme.title: DL Menarik Sepuluh
programme.desc: Menarik Sepuluh mengumpulkan 10 kisah unik dan menarik berlaku di mana sahaja

programme.title: L UTAMA 740
programme.desc: UTAMA 740 memaparkan berita terkini yang menyeluruh dan padat dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: DL Detik Dunia
programme.desc: Detik Dunia membawakan rangkuman berita antarabangsa, mengetengahkan perkembangan global serta kisah-kisah yang membentuk landskap dunia hari ini.

programme.title: Siti In The City
programme.desc: Siti, anak yatim piatu yang hanya mahu hidup tenang sebagai content creator, tiba-tiba jadi terkenal kerana fitnah. Tapi, kebenaran terbongkar, dan dia naik sebagai content creator kegemaran ramai.

programme.title: Dialog TVS
programme.desc: Dialog TVS merupakan program bual bicara yang membincangkan mengenai perkembangan terkini serta topik-topik tertentu bersama pemimpin, pakar, penganalisis dan pemain industri.

programme.title: L TVS Nightline
programme.desc: Memaparkan laporan peristiwa yang berlaku di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa English

programme.title: My Bubble Tea
programme.desc: On her 24th birthday, love never lost magical bubble tea is given to Modem as a gift. She insists never to use it. Magic-induced love can never be true. The universe suddenly proves her wrong as that tea, thinking that she threw it away, is served right down to the helmet of BearBike man.

programme.title: Aroma Malaysia
programme.desc: Aroma Malaysia menampilkan eksplorasi kulinari yang memperkenalkan hidangan tradisional dan tempatan, diperkaya dengan pengalaman pengembaraan merentasi pelbagai destinasi budaya

programme.title: Agrotech Heroes
programme.desc: AGROTECH HEROES, aims to nurture future Sarawak farmers by involving six contestants in 13 challenges involving agriculture, technology, and entrepreneurship for the grand prize of RM10,000

programme.title: Barbarossa
programme.desc: During the reign of the Ottoman Empire, four brothers from Lesvos face many dangers and become the conquerors of the seas

programme.title: Alunan Borneo
programme.desc: Alunan Borneo, sebuah travelog seorang anak seni untuk mengenali lebih dekat tentang muzikirama tradisi etnik di Bumi Kenyalang dan berkenalan dengan lebih dekat dengan etnik-etnik di Sarawak.

programme.title: Aroma Puncak Borneo
programme.desc: Catatan perjalanan seorang nomad, eksplorasi masakan dan makanan unik etnik di pergunungan tanah tinggi, selain menemukan pengalaman baharu mengenai adat, budaya dan tradisi..

programme.title: Sarawak Angler
programme.desc: Program realiti memancing laut dalam di perairan Sarawak diadakan bagi menduga dan mencari spesies ikan hebat.Pemancing profesional dari Sarawak telah dipilih untuk bertanding dalam program realiti ini.

programme.title: Kediaman Agro
programme.desc: KEDIAMAN AGRO merupakan program dokumentari yang menumpukan kepada teknologi penanaman makanan berskala kecil seperti di kawasan rumah, mahupun mini kebun.

programme.title: Kek Pastri
programme.desc: Kek Pastri Siri 2 menampilkan selebriti mencipta resepi kek, pastri, dan hidangan savouri menggunakan bahan tempatan dan teknik membakar serta mengukus untuk hasil yang lazat dan inovatif.

programme.title: My Body, My Life!
programme.desc: My Body, My Life! is a TV series tackling obesity-related diseases, offering expert insights, real-life stories, and practical health strategies to empower Sarawaks community for a healthier future.

programme.title: Borneos Unique Building
programme.desc: Siri dokumentari yang memfokuskan kepada senibina bangunan dan infrastruktur di Sarawak, yang menampilkan dua binaan iaitu satu senibina modenkontemporari dan satu lagi senibina tradisikolonial.

programme.title: Belawan Memasak
programme.desc: Dua selebriti Cef, Pison Jaujip Sabah dan Achang Libat Sarawak, bersaing memasak menggunakan bahan utama dari hutan atau pasar, dengan cara masakan berbeza, untuk menjadi pemenang 6 episod.

programme.title: Journey of The Bidayuh
programme.desc: James Ritchie will take us to discover more about the Bidayuh. A documentary series that will touch on the aspects of Bidayuh culture, tradition, history and where this race fares in todays world.

programme.title: My Health, My Choice
programme.desc: My Health, My Choice explores daily practices, behaviors, and health issues, highlighting factors like attitudes, diet, environment, and relationships, and provides practical solutions.

programme.title: L TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Dilan 1991
programme.desc: Sambungan kisah cinta Dilan dan Milea selepas mereka menjadi pasangan. Hubungan mereka mula diuji apabila Dilan semakin terlibat dengan geng motor dan pergaduhan di sekolah, menyebabkan Milea risau dan hubungan mereka menjadi tegang. Milea terpaksa membuat keputusan yang sukar demi masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Jika Fattah
programme.desc: Kehadiran Fattah yang merupakan seorang anak yatim di dalam keluarga Zaidi telah mengubah kehidupan mereka sekeluarga melalui sikap terpuji yang ada di dalam diri Fattah yang menyedarkan Zaidi dan isterinya Intan.

programme.title: Salina
programme.desc: Salina tinggal di sebuah banglo cantik yang mempunyai sejarah misteri. Apabila kejadian aneh dan menakutkan mula berlaku, terutamanya terhadap anak-anaknya, Salina mula menyiasat sejarah banglo itu untuk melindungi mereka. Namun, keadaan menjadi semakin teruk sehingga membawa kepada kematian yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Taikun
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua lelaki bernama Tai dan Kun, sahabat baik yang hanya meminati pergaduhan dan mencuri. Apabila tabiat buruk mereka menyebabkan mereka bertembung dan memukul teruk ahli geng Pink dan Purple, Tai dan Kun kemudian direkrut oleh ketua geng yang kagum dengan kemahiran mereka.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Olimpias Way
programme.desc: Seorang penyanyi pop berusia 70 tahun yang pernah menjadi legenda muzik memulakan satu perjalanan merentasi tempat-tempat yang pernah menaikkan namanya. Dia menyewa seorang gadis muda yang pemalu sebagai pemandu, dan bersama-sama mereka melalui perjalanan emosi yang penuh kenangan, perubahan diri, dan hubungan antara dua generasi. Sepanjang perjalanan itu, mereka mula memahami erti kehidupan, kehilangan, dan kebebasan untuk memilih jalan sendiri.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Zharfa
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan Zharfa, seorang gadis Malaysia yang penuh pemberontakan dan emosional, sejak ditinggalkan oleh ayah kandungnya ketika berusia satu tahun. Selepas ibunya berkahwin dengan lelaki licik, konflik antara Zharfa dan bapa tirinya semakin memuncak. Akhirnya, dia dihantar ke sebuah pesantren di pedalaman Jawa Barat, Indonesia, di mana wataknya terus berkembang dalam latar budaya dan agama yang kuat

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahandihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Surat Kecil Untuk Tuhan
programme.desc: Kisah dua beradik yatim piatu, Anton dan Angel, yang terpisah selepas kemalangan ketika hidup dalam sindiket pengemis jalanan. Bertahun kemudian, Angel yang telah berjaya sebagai peguam kembali ke Jakarta untuk mencari semula abangnya yang hilang.

programme.title: Jeriji Patin
programme.desc: Rizal, seorang bekas banduan yang baru dibebaskan dari penjara. Dengan perasaan yang cekal untuk buktikan dia seorang yang masih berguna kepada masyarakat dia kuatkan semangat untuk pulang ke kampung semula lalu membuka sebuah kedai makan.

programme.title: Sifu Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Dilan 1990
programme.desc: Cerita cinta remaja antara Dilan, seorang pelajar yang unik dan romantik, dengan Milea, pelajar baru yang berpindah ke Bandung pada tahun 1990. Cara Dilan yang berbeza dalam mendekati Milea membuatkan hubungan mereka berkembang, tetapi mereka juga perlu menghadapi cabaran persahabatan, sekolah dan kehidupan remaja.

programme.desc: Kisah pasangan warga emas, Jaap dan Maartje, yang mengembara ke Sepanyol untuk bertemu sahabat lama. Perjalanan tersebut membuka kembali kenangan lama serta membantu mereka menemukan semula makna cinta dan hubungan mereka selepas bertahun bersama.

programme.title: DAcademy 7
programme.desc: D Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai DAcademy musim ketujuh?

programme.title: Hi Guys
programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Hatiku Tercipta Untukmu
programme.desc: Zaki Ridho Illahi, seorang ejen hartanah, gigih bekerja demi menyara dua adiknya walaupun sering berdepan masalah kewangan. Hidupnya mula berubah selepas bertemu Alisa Shanice Margaretha, namun kebahagiaan mereka diuji apabila Yudi Adhitya Alkatiri, sahabat yang juga saudara tirinya, berusaha menghancurkan segala yang dimiliki Zaki.

programme.title: Mega Series Suara Hati Istri: Anjani
programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: Doyan Makan
programme.desc: Doyan Makan menjemput penonton untuk mengikuti perjalanan dan pengalaman kulinari untuk makanan popular di kawasan tersebut, serta akan meninjau informasi tentang tempat, harga dan proses penghasilan makanan yang mereka nikmati.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Qari Cilik Season 3
programme.desc: Qari Cilik Indonesia kembali untuk musim ketiga, menampilkan kanak-kanak berbakat dalam seni tilawah Al-Quran. Saksikan perjalanan para peserta muda dalam menyampaikan bacaan yang indah dan penuh makna.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Gak Pengen Jadi Ipar Pengennya Jadi Pacar
programme.desc: Wini Indah Nicole tiba-tiba dia menabrak seorang laki-laki ban sepedanya menyentuh bagian vital laki-laki tersebut. Wini harus berurusan dengan Dito Hardi Fadhillah yang merasa dirugikan untuk masa depannya. Suatu ketika, Wini mempertemukan adiknya dengan Dito dan memaksa untuk menikah. Namun anehnya, hati kecil Indah menolak, sebenarnya dia itu menyukai laki-laki yang dia jodohkan dengan adiknya

programme.title: Indonesia Pintar
programme.desc: Rancangan permainan terbesar di Indonesia yang mempertandingkan kecerdasan dan kecekapan 100 pelajar sekolah. Program ini diisi dengan pelbagai permainan menarik dan hadiah keseluruhan bernilai jutaan rupiah.

programme.title: Juara Indonesia
programme.desc: Helo para guru dan murid-murid sekolah rendah di seluruh Indonesia! Uji pengetahuan dan ketangkasan dalam menjawab soalan dengan cepat dan tepat dalam Juara Indonesia.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN Lau Dan built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI Koni Lui, is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE Andrea So, often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today
programme.desc: After being murdered in a planned palace fire, Queen Gu Qing is reborn as Feng Qing, a lowly palace maid. Stripped of her royal status, she embarks on a dangerous mission to protect her younger sister from deadly royal schemes and uncover the truth to bring her murderers to justice

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded
programme.desc: The program focuses on various serious illnesses, explaining their causes, pathological mechanisms, latest treatment options, and prevention methods in an accessible way. Shaun Tam, Hera Chan, ,Kirby Lam and Carina Leung become investigators in the Critical Care Unit, searching far and wide for clues, evidence, and witnesses to unravel the mysteries surrounding various deadly diseases. Senior doctors and scholars from major public and private hospitals in Hong Kong, as well as local university medical schools, combine real case studies and medical images to make complex medical knowledge relatable, enabling the public to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the diagnosis and treatment of serious illnesses, reducing misunderstandings and fear, and encouraging Hong Kong residents to get early checkups and timely treatment to safeguard their future health.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Walking With You
programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. This trip to Malaysia was a rare girls getaway, filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. They visited durian orchards to enjoy fresh Musang King durians, picked vegetables and coconuts in vegetable gardens, explored the rainforest, and visited luxurious houses, experiencing a different side of Malaysia. programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!
